hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: Work backwards from the target point total toward zero.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: At value n, moving backwards by dividing by two or three takes advantage of exponential reductions.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: The cost to reach a multiple of d is (n % d) unit increments plus one division step.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Memoized recursive division bounds state space to O(log(n)^2).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Linear forward DP visits up to 10^9 states.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identifies backward division to achieve sublinear complexity.
